notes:
【实验版】改动较大，可能有未发现的问题。不想升级可以点更新卡片上的「稍后再说 / ✕」。
液态玻璃重做：悬浮的按钮组、导入按钮、提示条不再是毛玻璃，而是一枚枚透镜——几乎不模糊，后面的内容透过来仍然清楚，只在边缘被折射掰弯。Android 10 起都是实时的。
滑杆与开关重写：按住滑块，它会「绽开」成一枚清透镜，里面是被折射的轨道；拖动时跟手、被拉长，松手回弹。分段控件的选中块可以直接拖。
新增「主题」：跟随系统 / 浅色 / 深色；深色下可开「纯黑」，背景是真正的 #000000，适合 OLED 屏幕。在「怎么用」或「阅读样式」的「外观」里。
面板改为实心，文字更清楚；书架加了一层很淡的环境光。按钮、面板、提示条的动效更有弹性。
notesEn:
[Experimental] Bigger changes; there may be undiscovered issues. To skip it, tap the X on the update card.
Liquid glass, rebuilt: the floating button groups, the Import button and toasts are now clear lenses instead of frosted panels. What is behind them stays sharp and bends at the edges. It is live on Android 10 and later.
New sliders and switches: hold a thumb and it blooms into a clear lens with the track refracted inside; it follows your finger, stretches as it moves and bounces back on release. The selected segment in a segmented control can be dragged.
New Theme setting: System, Light or Dark. In the dark theme you can turn on Pure black, a true #000000 background for OLED screens. Find it under Appearance in How to use or Reading style.
Panels are now solid, so text is easier to read; the library has a soft ambient glow. Buttons, panels and toasts have bouncier motion.
